PluginData.Author: Squeech007
PluginData.Tooltip: Compact colored HUD. First Tab: signals only. Second Tab: full HUD.
PluginData.Description: A compact, colored HUD with a signals-only mode. Press Tab once for a clean screen that still shows GPS, antennas, ore and unknown signals; press again for the full colored HUD. Credits: colors inspired by Color Hud (Apex) by Javert, signals-only idea from Signal HUD by Patrick. Replaces the default HUD, so do not combine with other HUD mods.
